phases.label: Levels 1-3
goals: Farm safely and poke with Seismic Shard while Granite Shield is up; you are weak early.
Reach level 3 with Q, E and W for your first real trade.
Keep CS even and save your mana for Q.
do: Take Q at level 1, E at 2, W at 3 (Q > E > W is the max order).
Poke with Q when the enemy steps up to last-hit, then step back so Granite Shield recharges.
Use Q's movement speed to walk away from melee champions or to stop them from closing.
At level 3 trade with W, Q, auto and E in one burst, then leave.
Ping your jungler when the enemy is out of position so the wave decides the trade.
dont: Don't take long trades against sustained melee damage before level 3.
Don't waste Q on an empty wave; Doran's Ring mana is limited.
Don't push the wave into the enemy without knowing where their jungler is.
ifAhead: Shove and Q-poke them off CS, then take plates; plates are permanent so no rush.
Ping your jungler for a dive with the wave pushed in.
ifEven: Farm, poke with Q when your shield is up, and trade only with Q, W and E ready.
Keep the wave near the middle of the lane.
ifBehind: Let the wave come to your tower, farm under it and only last-hit.
Play for level 6 and Sunfire Aegis; take Doran's Shield next game against melee bullies.

phases.label: Levels 4-5
goals: Crash the wave, recall for Bami's Cinder at about 900 gold, and return to farm.
Max Q first and stay even in CS for level 6.
Watch the river; the 5:00 dragon pulls the jungler away from you.
do: Crash the wave into the enemy turret before you recall so you lose no minions.
Poke with Q on caster and cannon minions you can hit, then walk out of range.
Use E to clear the wave and to cripple an auto-attacker in trades.
Trade when your shield is up and their key skill is used; then let the shield recharge.
Ward the tri-brush or river before you push past the middle.
dont: Don't stay in lane at low HP after your shield is gone; recall instead.
Don't walk up for a trade with Q on cooldown; you cannot stop them from leaving.
Don't fight sustained auto-attackers at length without armor.
ifAhead: Push and take plates; each one is permanent and counts for your top quest.
Look for a dive with your jungler and save the kill for level 6.
ifEven: Slow push, then recall on a crash; farm safely and wait for level 6.
Take short trades with the shield and Q only.
ifBehind: Hold the wave near your tower, last-hit and buy Bami's Cinder.
Buy Cloth Armor or Chain Vest if an AD champion is beating you.

phases.label: Level 6 to first item
goals: Set up a kill with Unstoppable Force and your jungler; push the wave first.
Finish Sunfire Aegis and stay top for the role quest.
Push first, then join your jungler at the 8:00 Voidgrubs.
do: At level 6 push the wave, then Q to slow, R onto your opponent when your jungler is close, and follow with E and W.
Ask your jungler for a gank when the wave is pushed into their turret.
Use R also to escape: you cannot be stopped while dashing.
Crash the wave before the 8:00 Voidgrubs; W and E clear waves quickly.
Finish the top quest by farming your lane; you then get a free Teleport (or a shield on Teleport).
dont: Don't use R alone on one target unless it gets you a kill or saves you.
Don't R in without checking where the enemy jungler is.
Don't leave a big wave pushing into you for the grubs.
ifAhead: Use R for a kill with your jungler, then take plates and the turret.
Use Teleport to join Voidgrubs or dragon fights.
ifEven: Farm to Sunfire Aegis, push waves and use R to pick a kill when your jungler is near.
Fight when their key skill is used and your Q, E and W are up.
ifBehind: Farm under tower; R is your escape or punish if they overextend.
Skip the grubs unless your team has priority; buy armor if AD hits you.

phases.label: First item to ~14 minutes
goals: Use the Sunfire Aegis spike to push the wave and take the turret.
Buy Plated Steelcaps, then Thornmail (or Frozen Heart against strong auto-attackers).
Set up the 15:00 Rift Herald and your Teleport.
do: Push with Sunfire Aegis and W autos to take turret plates; melee champions deal 20% more to turrets.
Push top wave before Herald so you can Teleport or walk to the pit in time.
Hold Teleport for dragon or Herald fights or to flank; walk back to lane if not needed.
Stack armor if their damage is AD; use Q to slow chasers.
dont: Don't Teleport into a fight that will be over before you land.
Don't leave your wave pushing into you when you go to an objective.
Don't chase after Q with no vision; you can get caught.
ifAhead: Take the turret and use Teleport to flank at dragon or Herald.
Force the enemy to send help so your team gets an objective.
ifEven: Push, then help at Herald or dragon with Teleport.
Play the first fight of the map around your R.
ifBehind: Farm safely, buy Plated Steelcaps and armor, and use Teleport to join team fights.
Stay near your team and R only when they can follow up.

phases.label: Midgame
goals: Group with your team and land R on two or more enemies around dragons and Baron.
Build Thornmail or Frozen Heart against auto-attackers, then Jak'Sho, The Protean.
do: Push the side wave, then Teleport or walk to the objective before it spawns.
Aim R at two or more enemies or at a carry; use Q to slow stragglers.
Use W for armor and to cut through the front line, and E on auto-attackers.
Let your team see you before the fight: your R starts it.
Side lane only to push a wave that helps you Teleport or flank.
dont: Don't side lane with no vision when three or more enemies are missing.
Don't R into their full team with no follow-up from your team.
Don't stand alone on the wrong side when Baron or dragon starts.
ifAhead: Group and use R to take Baron or a fight, then push turrets together.
Take plates and turrets on the side where Teleport is available.
ifEven: Group up, wait for a chance to R their carries and fight at objectives.
Push the wave first, then join your team.
ifBehind: Be the frontline; your armor keeps you alive and one good R turns the fight.
Stay with your team and farm safe waves.

phases.label: Lategame
goals: Be the frontline: land R on several enemies or their carry, then peel with E and Q.
Stay with your team for Baron, Elder Dragon and inhibitors.
Respect death timers; don't get caught alone.
do: Wait until their key CC or engage is used before you R in.
R onto their carries and squishies rather than tanks if you can reach them.
Use E on auto-attackers and Q to slow whoever chases your team.
Buy Randuin's Omen against crit ADCs and items that match their damage type.
Peel for your carries when the enemy dives; you are the wall.
dont: Don't split alone without Teleport or vision.
Don't R first into a full team if your team is not close enough to follow.
Don't face-check brush; a pick means a lost objective.
ifAhead: Engage with R onto carries and end with Baron or inhibitors.
Take turrets with your team after every won fight.
ifEven: Group for Baron or Elder Dragon; hold R until the enemy commits or is out of position.
Side lane only when your team is safe and Teleport is up.
ifBehind: Group up and use R as your team's best chance to catch one carry.
Play near turrets and R in return after the enemy engages.

trading: Poke with Q when Granite Shield is up, then step back so the shield recharges before the next trade.
Q gives you movement speed equal to the slow: use it to walk away, to stop a melee champion from closing, or to catch one who runs.
Full trade at level 3+: W, Q, auto, E, then leave; E's attack speed cripple is strongest on auto-attackers.
Trade after the enemy used their key skill on a minion or missed it.
Against ranged champions take Doran's Shield, play for waves under tower and poke back with Q.
Against sustained melee champions, don't extend a long trade; Q, E and back off.
Don't trade when your shield is broken and Q is on cooldown.
waveManagement: Farm with Q on cannon and caster minions only if mana allows; E and W clear waves faster later.
In a bad matchup freeze near your tower and last-hit; let the enemy come to you.
Slow push into level 6 so your jungler can gank; a big wave in front of their turret gives a safe R dive.
Crash the wave before every recall and before dragon (5:00), Voidgrubs (8:00), Herald (15:00) and Baron (20:00).
Sunfire Aegis clears waves quickly: push before you go to an objective, then Teleport or walk.
Farm top for the role quest: minions and plates count most in top lane.

when: OK when the wave gives you a safe Teleport flank on the next objective and you can see the map.
OK when the enemy is missing players and your team can hold without you.
Rare: you are a tank engage champion, not a duelist, so grouping is your default.
rules: Push the side wave only if you can see where the enemy jungler and most of their team are.
Never duel an enemy carry for the turret; if one or two enemies come, walk back to your team and ping an objective.
Don't side lane when Baron or dragon is about to spawn unless Teleport is up.
Hit turrets with Sunfire Aegis and W autos; plates are permanent, so take them when it is safe.
Leave the side lane once the wave crashes: the goal is the fight, not the lane.
tpUsage: Save Teleport for a fight or objective: land on a ward, minion or ally on a flank, then R their carries.
Push the wave before you Teleport so you do not lose it.
After the top quest your Teleport is free (or has a shield if you took Teleport); plan objectives around it.
Don't Teleport into a fight that will be over before you land.

teamfight.role: Frontline engage: R onto several enemies or their carries, then stay on them with W armor, E attack speed cripple and Q slow. Peel for your carries when the enemy dives.
rules: Set up R around a wall or from a bush; aim to hit two or more champions or a carry.
Wait for their key CC or engage to be used before you R if you can.
After R, use Q on whoever runs and E on auto-attackers.
Use W for armor while you hit the front line, and stay near your carries when the enemy dives.
R when your team is close enough to follow up; a lone R can lose the fight.
Buy armor against AD carries and magic resist against AP mages.
targetPriority: Their carries (ADC or mid laner) in R range.
Otherwise the group of enemies standing together.
Assassins or divers who jump on your carries.

objectives: Dragon spawns at 5:00 (5:00 respawn); Soul needs 4 drakes, Elder comes 6:00 after. Push top first, then Teleport or walk to the pit.
Voidgrubs: 8:00, one camp of 3, despawn 14:45. Crash your wave, then help your jungler; grubs add turret damage.
Rift Herald: 15:00, despawns 19:45. Push top first; the Herald can take a top turret if used there.
Baron: 20:00, then 6:00 after each kill. Be with your team at full HP with R ready; R knocks up whoever contests it.
Atakhan was removed in 2026; plan around dragon, Herald and Baron.
Turret plates are permanent and exist on inner and inhibitor turrets; Sunfire Aegis and W autos take them fast.
Set up fights at objectives: Teleport flank, then R on the carries as they try to take it.
mechanics: Granite Shield: a shield of 10% max HP that returns after a few seconds without damage; poke and walk out to recharge.
Q Seismic Shard: slows the target and gives you the same movement speed; use it to chase or to run.
W Thunderclap: passive armor bonus is tripled while the shield is up; active makes your next attack hit harder and hit in a cone.
E Ground Slam: damage scales with armor and cripples attack speed; hit auto-attackers and clear waves with it.
R Unstoppable Force: dash to a point and knock up everything hit; you cannot be stopped by displacement while dashing, so it is also an escape.
Aim R at where enemies will stand, not where they are; Q slow first helps.
Armor items raise your E and W damage as well as your survivability.
Use Flash after R to catch a target outside its range, or line R up over a wall.
Combos: W > Q > AA > E for a trade; Q > R > E > W for a pick or an engage.

recallTimings.note: First back toward Sunfire Aegis; crash the wave first, add a Control Ward with spare gold.

recallTimings.buy: Bami's Cinder plus Cloth Armor or Chain Vest
recallTimings.note: If AD champions are beating you and you need armor now.

recallTimings.buy: Chain Vest and Ruby Crystal toward Sunfire Aegis
recallTimings.note: Second back; Sunfire Aegis costs 2,800 total, so finish it on the back after.

recallTimings.buy: Plated Steelcaps (vs AD/autos) or Mercury's Treads (vs AP/CC)
recallTimings.note: Usually the recall right after Sunfire Aegis.

recallTimings.buy: Thornmail (or Frozen Heart against strong auto-attackers)
recallTimings.note: Third item; Thornmail earlier if they have healing.
If you must recall early, buy a ward and a Health Potion; a Control Ward near dragon or Baron helps your team.

commonMistakes: Trading without your Granite Shield up or with Q on cooldown.
Fighting long trades against sustained melee champions in the early game.
Using R alone into their team instead of waiting for your team to follow.
Using R on one target without a follow-up or a kill.
Side laning without vision when Baron or dragon is about to spawn.
Building damage items instead of armor against AD auto-attackers.
Not buying Thornmail against healing champions.

enemy_laner_dead: Push the wave into their turret and take plates.
Crash and recall to buy your next item, then Teleport back or walk.
you_died_to_gank: Ward the river and keep the wave near your tower.
Keep Q ready for the jungler's approach; R can escape.
you_died_solo: Wait for your shield and Q before you trade again.
Farm under tower; play for level 6 and Sunfire Aegis.
opp_level_lead: They are a level up; don't trade until you catch up.
Farm under tower and poke with Q only if your shield is up.
you_level_lead: You are a level up: W, Q, E trade now before they catch up.
Check where their jungler is first.
you_hit_level_2_first: Level 2 first: Q and E burst, then walk out before they level.
you_hit_6: R ready: push the wave, then ask your jungler for a kill with R.
Don't R alone; find your jungler first.
first_item_done: Sunfire Aegis done: push the wave and take the turret plates.
second_item_done: Two items: you are very tanky, so lead fights with R around objectives.
three_items_done: Three items: hard to kill; R onto their carries and be the frontline.
you_are_fed: Stay with your team and R their carries; you are hard to kill.
Take turrets after every won fight.
you_are_behind: Farm safely, buy armor and group; one good R still wins fights.
Stay near your team as the frontline.
enemy_laner_fed: Don't 1v1 them; buy armor early and ask your jungler for help.
Use R and E in team fights, when your team can follow up.
enemy_team_numbers_down: You have more players: R onto whoever is left or take the next objective.
Crash your wave on the way.
your_team_numbers_down: Your team is down players; don't fight. Clear the wave under your turret and wait.
baron_up_soon: Baron soon: push your wave, then group with your team and keep Teleport ready.
Be at full HP with R ready before it spawns.
dragon_up_soon: Dragon soon: crash top and Teleport or walk to the pit with your team.
Set up R on whoever contests it.
grubs_soon: Grubs at 8:00: crash your wave and go with your jungler.
Don't go if the enemy gets there first.
herald_soon: Herald at 15:00: push top first, then help take it.
enemy_jungler_ganked_top_repeatedly: Keep the wave near your tower and ward the river.
Poke with Q only when the jungler is not showing.
long_death_timers: Death timers are long: don't side lane without vision.
Stay with your team and wait for their engage before you R.
enemy_has_heavy_healing: Burst the healer with R, Q and E so they can't heal.
enemy_heavy_ap: Heavy AP: buy Mercury's Treads, then Force of Nature or Kaenic Rookern.
Your Granite Shield helps against burst; keep it up.
enemy_heavy_ad: Heavy AD: Plated Steelcaps, Thornmail and Frozen Heart.
Use E on their auto-attackers to cut their damage.
enemy_many_tanks: Many tanks: R still helps your team, but pick the carry behind them.
Consider Liandry's Torment after your defensive items.
enemy_heavy_cc: Heavy CC: buy Mercury's Treads and wait for their CC to be used before you R.
Use Flash after R to catch a target if needed.
turret_lost: Your turret is down: stay with your team and clear waves near the next turret.
enemy_turret_taken: Turret taken: move to the next objective or lane with your team.
Hit inner turret plates; they are permanent.
